statement: Mutated Mush is the World 4 mini boss located in the Spaceway Raceway map
To fight Mutated Mush you need either a Barrel of Toxic Sludge or Radioactive Waste
Toxic Sludge is a common drop from Jungle Slimes in World 1
Radioactive Waste is a random reward from turning in Post Office orders
Need at least 2250 accuracy for 5% hit chance or 6750 for 100% hit chance against Mutated Mush
He hits very hard so bring plenty of food; not currently possible to get enough defense to ignore his damage
Summon the boss on the top platform of Spaceway Raceway by dropping Barrels on top of the mushrooms
Mushrooms disappear on summon and respawn on a timer with a minimum of 4 days for the first mushroom
Mushrooms accumulate so you needn't fight every four days but the timer slows with each; up to 8 accumulate over 67 days
Days only accumulate on days you log into at least one character; log in daily for minimum timer
You do not need to visit the map for the respawn days to count
He damages you when he runs over you but mainly summons lightning storms similar to Amarok
Each mushroom boss has about 120 million HP; damage is not that bad with a full Dementia gear set
Common drops include Coins XP Balloons and Time Candies
Main drop is the Mutated Mushroom card
Boss can drop Dawn Stopwatch Recipe giving 2% skill AFK gain rate and 1% skill efficiency
Boss can drop Souped Lab Ring Recipe giving 25% Lab XP and 35% Lab efficiency
Boss can drop Pet Eggs for more breeding chances
Boss can drop Cooking Ladles to speed up cooking
